newsitem.title: USA: Marvel's Icahn management and banks back in court.
newsitem.headline: Marvel's Icahn management and banks back in court.

text.p: The recently installed management of Marvel Entertainment Group Inc faces a court battle Tuesday with the company's pre-petition bank lenders over an old issue: who gets what share of Marvel's assets.

The Carl Icahn-led group of Marvel Holdings Inc bondholders, who last month won a prolonged legal battle to take control of the debtor companies, "want the right to use cash collateral over pre-petition lenders and debtor-in- possession lenders," an attorney in the case told Reuters.

Chase Manhattan Corp, the agent for both sets of lenders, said it will oppose Icahn's proposal to lend Marvel $125 million to be used for operations and to retire the DIP debt of $95 million, court papers say.
Chase objects because under the new arrangement it would be bumped from its first lien position to second by the new DIP lender, the Icahn-controlled High River LP.
The pre-petition lenders have a secured claim of $610 million.
A hearing is scheduled at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT before U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Helen Balick.
